user_story:
As a user, I want to view a product catalogue with sorting functionality, so that I can easily find items based on my preferences. Acceptance Criteria: 
1. The user can see the products listed on the page with the text 'Products' visible via [data-test='title']. 
2. The user can sort the products by 'Name (A to Z)', 'Name (Z to A)', 'Price (low to high)', and 'Price (high to low)' using the dropdown selector [data-test='product-sort-container']. 
3. After selecting a sorting option, the product list should update accordingly and remain on the same page (URL should still be 'https://www.saucedemo.com/inventory.html').
